话分两头，这时，95号院可正在不声不响的发生着一场勾心斗角。在四合院的后院易中海家。易中海满脸怒容：“大清，当年的事儿就是查不清了。”

何大清倒也不恼：“老易，咱俩当年的关系也算不错。多了我也不问，当年的事儿是怎么回事儿，你也清楚。但是这些年的账，咱俩得算算。”

“我和你有什么账要算？”

“什么账？呵呵，易中海你是真不知道，还是装傻呢！”

“什么装傻不装傻的，有什么话你就说。”

“那我问你，这八年多，我给柱子和雨水的生活费哪儿去了？”

易中海磕磕巴巴的说：“这……这......我不是觉得柱子还小，我替他收着呢！我想等他结婚了再给他。”

何大清冷冷一笑：“易中海，你别跟我说这些没用的。这钱在哪儿，你为什么不给柱子，我都清楚。都是千年的狐狸，你跟我玩聊斋，是不是有点儿多余了！”

“大清，你要说要这些钱，我现在给你不就完了？”

“易中海，现在不是你给不给我的问题，我也跟你明说了，我已经去邮局开了证明了。这些年我寄了多少钱，什么时候寄的，证明上写的清清楚楚。

而且我还去了四九城的邮局，把你每次取钱的证明也开了。易中海你说我要是把这些证明送进派出所，你易中海是个什么结果？”

易中海咬着后槽牙说：“何大清，你这是要整死我呀！”

何大清呵呵一笑：“易中海，你也不是什么正人君子，你最多算个伪君子，我也不跟你浪费唾沫星子了。证据我有，我想什么时候整死你就什么时候，要想我放你一马也不是不行。”

易中海瞬间蔫了：“什么条件，你说吧！”

“其实不难，第一，你给我写一份认罪书，你得保证以后不能招我们何家；第二，把这些年的钱，给我一分不少的拿出来。”

易中海仿佛瞬间老了十岁：“好，我答应你，可是我怎么知道你以后会不会再拿这个要挟我。”

“易中海，不要把人想得和你一样，我们何家没这种人。我们只想和你以后井水不犯河水，你继续做你的一大爷。至于你养老的问题，只要不涉及我们家，我才懒得理你。至于你想要我保证，呵呵，你是想瞎想了心了，我什么也给你保证不了。”

“你……”

“怎么不同意？”

“我能不同意吗？”

“你觉得呢？”何大清威胁的眯了眯眼。

“好，我写。”

说完，易中海就写了一份认罪书，何大清还让他签字按上了手印。何大清仔细的看了好几遍，发现里面没有猫腻，就郑重的收进自己兜里。

就在易中海准备去拿钱时，何大清拦着了他，说：“易中海，咱俩还有一笔账没算呢！”

易中海瞪大眼睛问：“还有什么？”

The words were divided into two parts, and at this time, a conspiracy was quietly taking place in No. 95 Courtyard.Yi Zhonghai's house is in the backyard of the courtyard.Yi Zhonghai's face was full of anger: "Qing Dynasty, we just can't find out what happened back then."

He Daqing was not annoyed at all: "Lao Yi, we had a pretty good relationship back then. I won't ask if there are any more. You also know what happened back then. But we have to settle the accounts over the years."

"What accounts do I have to settle with you?"

"What account? Haha, Yi Zhonghai, do you really not know, or are you just pretending to be stupid?"

"What's wrong with pretending to be stupid? If you have anything to say, just say it."

"Then let me ask you, where have the living expenses I paid for Zhuzi and Yuyu gone over the past eight years?"

Yi Zhonghai stuttered and said: "This... this... I don't think the pillar is still small. I'm keeping it for him! I want to wait until he gets married before giving it to him."

He Daqing smiled coldly: "Yi Zhonghai, don't tell me these useless things. I know where the money is and why you didn't give it to Zhuzi. We are all foxes with thousands of years. It's a bit redundant for you to play chat with me!"

"Da Qing, if you want this money, won't it be over if I give it to you now?"

"Yi Zhonghai, it's not a question of whether you give it to me or not. I told you clearly that I have already gone to the post office to issue a certificate. How much I have sent over the years and when I sent it are clearly written on the certificate.

Moreover, I also went to the post office in Sijiucheng and issued a certificate for each withdrawal of money.Yi Zhonghai, if I send these certificates to the police station, what will happen to you Yi Zhonghai?"

Yi Zhonghai gritted his molars and said, "He Daqing, you are trying to kill me!"

He Daqing chuckled: "Yi Zhonghai, you are not a gentleman. You are a hypocrite at best. I won't waste my saliva on you anymore. I have the evidence. I can torture you to death whenever I want. It's not impossible for me to let you go if you want."

Yi Zhonghai instantly fainted: "You tell me what the conditions are!"

"It's actually not difficult. First, you write me a confession, and you have to promise not to recruit our He family in the future; second, give me every penny of your money over the years."

Yi Zhonghai seemed to have aged ten years in an instant: "Okay, I promise you, but how do I know if you will blackmail me with this again in the future."

"Yi Zhonghai, don't think of people like you. We don't have such people in our He family. We just want to be on the same page with you in the future, and you will continue to be your elder brother. As for the issue of your pension, as long as it doesn't involve our family, I won't bother to care about you. As for you wanting my guarantee, haha, you are just thinking nonsense, I can't guarantee you anything."

"You..."

"Why don't you agree?"

"Can I disagree?"

"What do you think?" He Daqing narrowed his eyes threateningly.

"Okay, I'll write."

After saying that, Yi Zhonghai wrote a confession, and He Daqing asked him to sign and fingerprint it.He Daqing looked at it carefully several times and found that there was nothing fishy inside, so he solemnly put it in his pocket.

Just when Yi Zhonghai was about to get the money, He Daqing stopped him and said, "Yi Zhonghai, we still have an unsettled account!"

Yi Zhonghai widened his eyes and asked, "What else?"
